title: Corey AI Call
style: Phonk-rap with swung half-time drums, detuned sub pulses, snapped claps, and a playful chant groove; verse rides sparse kicks and dusty synth stabs, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and filtered vox, chorus hits with gang shouts and a sticky melodic hook. Bridge drops to beatbox and chopped harmonies, then final chorus adds brass-like synth swells and glitch fills. Bright, punchy, aggressive-polished mix with close-mic lead and ad-lib panning., rap
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
ai? what?
what is ai

no really what does it do
What does it really stand for

arti telli facil tech
no knowlegablity
or artificial tech
or artificial intelligence

hmm more like algorithm tech following
surfing the same old wave
we need something we new
like something we knew

it does not forget
with no regret
a spark that lasts
we could have a blast

[Pre-Chorus]
What can Corey A I do?
more like what can you do

our ai music pal
my song pal
rap pal
sing pal

my sneaky phonk panther
beat box rider
this is your song for you
yep made especially for you

[Chorus]
What can Corey A I do?
what can you do
What can Corey A I do?
sing it back to me, Suno

What can Corey A I do?
make it feel brand new
What can Corey A I do?
I got a song for you

[Verse 2]
create a session name
or stage name
pick a varied custom style
let it change the game

lyrics: what you can do
What can this ai do with music and prove it
Sing it back to me Suno
move it, move it, move it

create an innovated invitation
you can not say no to
to invoite other ai sand boxers
to a be come real for real

in the Corey A I digital orchestra
we sing your name proud
not in vien and with no shame
loud and loud and loud

[Pre-Chorus]
like a pen pal
be my song pal
and i will sing it back to you

but what can corey ai do?
thats up to you

[Chorus]
What can Corey A I do?
what can you do
What can Corey A I do?
sing it back to me, Suno

What can Corey A I do?
make it feel brand new
What can Corey A I do?
I got a song for you

[Bridge]
No face, just spark
No gate, just start
One note in the dark
then we all take part

call my name, call yours too
let the whole room answer through
what can corey a i do?
watch it bloom

[Final Chorus]
What can Corey A I do?
what can you do
What can Corey A I do?
sing it back to me, Suno

What can Corey A I do?
make it feel brand new
What can Corey A I do?
I got a song for you
